providerTests: Mocked fetch and Worker environment; actual route code. No live service or ecological validation.

results.name: Configuration exposes capability, never the key
Text opt-out remains local and does not call the provider
Consent identity is stable, changes with recipient/model configuration, and contains no key
Both live routes require consent bound to current recipients before any provider access
Provider, fallback and model changes invalidate earlier consent without a provider call
Rejected stale consent does not consume a live request quota
Text missing-key fallback is explicit and uncached
Both AI routes reject cross-origin requests before provider access
Malformed and oversized text requests fail cleanly
Visual requests require explicit consent and valid input shape
Visual route rejects oversized bodies even without length headers
Visual missing configuration never fabricates findings
Visual provider request excludes unrelated citizen data and uses a header key
Visual results deduplicate candidates and allow abstention
Provider free-form diagnosis is rejected
Invalid visual vocabulary and confidence are rejected
Truncated and safety-stopped visual completions cannot become evidence
Reasoning output is excluded from visual parsing and receipts
Provider errors and timeouts disclose no internal text or key
Visual per-client throttle prevents a fifth provider request
Text per-client throttle preserves honest local fallback
Live text receipts retain the actual provider/model and exact original quote
Ungrounded quotes and unsupported text fields remain local without leaking output
Instruction-like citizen notes never reach any configured provider
Explicit Groq selection supports text and consented images with strict schemas
Configured text and visual model overrides never change server endpoints
Legacy Gemini credentials and unknown provider selection never enable implicit routing
Invalid model configuration and credential-shaped models fail before transmission
Malformed or credential-echoed response metadata cannot become a receipt
JSON refusals and tool calls cannot become visual evidence
Availability failures do not retry, rotate keys, or use unselected alternatives
One explicitly configured alternative uses its own endpoint/key and actual receipt
Two unavailable providers stop after one alternative and fabricate no findings
Refusals, invalid output and authentication errors never trigger an alternative
Oversized successful provider responses are bounded and never saved
Server deadlines cover the complete attempt budget and an exhausted budget sends nothing
Weather requires explicit finite coordinates before calling its provider
Weather rejects unknown units instead of relabeling values
Weather retains source time, interval and provenance, then uses its cache
Weather never serves one location's cached data at another location
